LASTARC.Tooltip.AttackCount: Multiattack: how many of this attack the creature makes per action. Stated on the card, not rolled automatically — each one resolves against its own defence and can be blocked separately.
LASTARC.Note.NeedsArcaneStudy: the Arcane Study technick is what lets you learn spells; tick it under Mechanical Effects on that technick.
LASTARC.Note.NeedsBardicStudy: the Bardic Study technick is what lets you learn performances; tick it under Mechanical Effects on that technick.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.weaponFinesse: Use the Agility modifier instead of Strength when calculating damage with light weapons, thrown weapons, unarmed attacks and natural attacks.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.preciseShot: Negates the −5 penalty for shooting into melee.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.tripleCrit: Ranged critical multiplier becomes ×3 instead of ×2.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.doubledExplosio: Each exploding die generates two dice rather than one.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.doubledSpellExp: Each exploding die on your SPELL damage generates two dice rather than one. Separate from the weapon flag above so a melee technick cannot double a spell. The sources for this are conditional, so switch the technick off when the condition does not apply.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.combatCasting: Casting with several threats nearby costs a single −5 rather than one per threat.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.debilitatingInj: Damage over the target's Threshold worsens the Break Gauge by two steps rather than one.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.arcaneStudy: Lets you learn spells from scrolls, 1 + Intelligence modifier of them (minimum 1). Repeatable — add a second Arcane Study technick to raise the limit again.
LASTARC.TechnickFlagHint.bardicStudy: Lets you learn performances from orchestral scores, 1 + Intelligence modifier of them (minimum 1). Repeatable — add a second Bardic Study technick to raise the limit again.
LASTARC.Note.TechnickActive: Switch off when the technick's condition is not met — Backstab doubles exploding dice on every attack otherwise, not just the one you are backstabbing with. Suspends this technick's grants as well as its effects.
LASTARC.Tooltip.TechnickActive: In effect. Switch off when the condition is not met; nothing this technick grants or changes will apply until it is switched back on.
LASTARC.Note.TechnickFlags: Tick what this technick changes in the rules engine. Only effects the system can act on are listed — anything else belongs in the description, and applies at the table.
LASTARC.Tooltip.WieldDerived: Wield category, derived from your size against the weapon's.
LASTARC.Tooltip.WeaponUnusable: This weapon is two or more size categories larger than you and cannot be used.
LASTARC.Card.MisfortuneDiscarded: Misfortune: rolled twice and kept the lower. This die was discarded.
LASTARC.Card.Combo: Combo — one free extra attack with the same weapon and target
LASTARC.Card.Critical: Critical — weapon damage dice are doubled
LASTARC.Card.ReactionWindow: The target may still Block or Dodge — these are opposed reactions and are not bypassed by an automatic hit.
LASTARC.Card.DiceCapped: Explosion cascade hit the dice cap and was truncated.
LASTARC.Card.Downed: reduced to 0 HP — unconscious, prone and helpless
LASTARC.Error.WeaponGone: That weapon is no longer on the actor.
LASTARC.Warning.NoTargets: No targets selected. Target one or more tokens first.
LASTARC.Warning.NoEffectToApply: This performance has nothing that can be applied as a standing effect.
LASTARC.Warning.WeaponUnusable: {weapon} is too large for {actor} to use.
LASTARC.Warning.EffectTargetUnsupported: "{name}" targets {paths}, which Last Arc recomputes after effects apply — the effect will have no visible result. Choose one of the listed targets instead.
LASTARC.Warning.ComboCapped: Combo chain reached the configured cap of {cap} and was stopped.
LASTARC.Note.NoTechnicks: No technicks or talents yet. Add one below and type in what your book says.
LASTARC.Tooltip.ToggleEquip: Equip or unequip. Only one armour and one shield can be equipped at a time.
LASTARC.EffectTarget.conditionalOnly: This applies only in a specific situation, so it cannot become a standing effect — a bonus written to the defence itself would also apply when the condition does not hold. Alt-click the roll to add it by hand.
LASTARC.EffectTarget.noDamageField: Damage is assembled at roll time from the weapon and the wielder's attribute, so there is no field for an effect to modify. Alt-click the damage roll to add it by hand.
LASTARC.EffectTarget.noStatblockSkills: A statblock keeps its skills as printed values rather than as slots an effect can modify, so a skill bonus or penalty cannot be applied to an NPC automatically — adjust the printed number, or apply it by hand at the roll.
LASTARC.EffectTarget.unknownScope: This system does not recognise that scope, so nothing was applied.
LASTARC.Note.WeaponDamageTypes: Tick every type this weapon can deal. Many weapons in the book list two — "Piercing or Slashing" — and with more than one ticked you are asked which you are using when you roll damage.
LASTARC.Note.NoDamageType: No type ticked — this weapon's damage counts as blunt.
LASTARC.DamageTypePrompt.Title: Which damage type?
LASTARC.DamageTypePrompt.Hint: {weapon} can deal more than one type. Pick the one you are using against this target.
LASTARC.Note.Grants: Numeric effects entered here are applied to the character automatically. Behavioural effects belong in flags or an Active Effect instead.
LASTARC.Note.SkillGrants: One row per skill this affects. Focus raises the skill's Focus, Bonus is a flat modifier, and Trained marks the skill trained even if the character never trained it. Rows with no skill chosen are ignored.
LASTARC.Note.NpcDefences: Enter the printed statblock values. The Break Gauge penalty is applied on top automatically.
LASTARC.Note.WieldNeedsActor: Wield category depends on the wielder's size, so it is shown only when this weapon is owned by an actor.
LASTARC.Tooltip.MaxAgiBonus: Hard cap on the Agility contribution to Reflex. Leave blank for no cap.
LASTARC.Tooltip.CheckPenalty: Enter as a positive number. It is subtracted from affected skills, and only when the wearer is not proficient with this armour type.
LASTARC.Tooltip.InitiativeSteps: Improved Initiative steps the die DOWN the ladder, because the lowest initiative acts first.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PrintedValue: The printed statblock value, before the Break Gauge.
LASTARC.Tooltip.FlatFootedOverride: Statblocks print this in parentheses. Leave blank to derive it as Ref minus the Agility bonus.
LASTARC.Tooltip.ThresholdOverride: Leave blank to derive Threshold from Fortitude.
LASTARC.Dialog.DeleteItem.title: Delete item?
LASTARC.Situational.Title: Situational modifier
LASTARC.Situational.Hint: Alt-click any roll to add a situational modifier and say why.
LASTARC.Note.ProficiencyPenalty: An attack with a weapon you are not proficient in takes −5. Armour you are not proficient in applies its check penalty to every Strength- and Agility-based skill.
LASTARC.Note.StatusesPersist: Statuses last until something clears them — they do not wear off at the end of a turn or an encounter. Toggling one here is the same as toggling it on the token.
LASTARC.Field.Name: Name
LASTARC.Break.AppliesTo: Applies to attacks, defences, skill checks, and attribute checks
LASTARC.Tooltip.ClearPersistent: Mark this condition cured. The step becomes ordinary and can then be recovered normally.
LASTARC.Tooltip.InjuryStep: Steps from injuries do not block natural healing, unlike other persistent conditions.
LASTARC.Warning.NaturalHealingBlocked: Natural healing is blocked while a non-injury persistent condition or an HP-affecting status is active.
LASTARC.Warning.RecoveryDisabled: Recovery actions are unavailable — disease blocks them entirely.
LASTARC.Dialog.AddPersistent.title: Add persistent Break condition
LASTARC.Dialog.AddPersistent.content: Each persistent step has its own source and its own clearance requirement, and each must be cleared separately.
LASTARC.Dialog.AddPersistent.fromInjury: From an injury (does not block natural healing)
LASTARC.HeroPoint.MisfortuneBlocks: Misfortune prevents rerolling d20s, including with a hero point.
LASTARC.Note.WeaponSkills: Weapon skills cannot Take 10 or Take 20. A natural 1 always fails and a natural 20 always succeeds, regardless of modifiers.
LASTARC.Tooltip.InitiativeInverted: Initiative is a class die, not a d20. Lowest result acts first; ties go to the higher Agility score.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SecondWind: Minor action, once per day. Cannot be used above half maximum HP.
LASTARC.Tooltip.Threshold: Break Threshold = Fortitude + size + technicks + items. Derived live, so each Break step lowers it.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SetBreakStep: Set the Break Gauge to this step
LASTARC.Tooltip.Recovery: Three consecutive minor actions improve the gauge by one step. Any other action — including a reaction — resets progress.
LASTARC.Dialog.RemoveFirstClass.title: Remove first class?
LASTARC.Dialog.RemoveFirstClass.content: The first class determines the character's level-1 HP and Mana grant and their class defence bonuses. Removing it promotes the next class into that role, which will change those values.
LASTARC.Info.RecoveryBanked: Recovery: {banked} of {required} consecutive minor actions banked.
LASTARC.Warning.Incapacitated: {name} is at the bottom of the Break Gauge and cannot act.
LASTARC.Warning.SkillBlocked: {name} cannot use {skill} — a status is blocking it.
LASTARC.NpcManual.title: Adjust by hand
LASTARC.NpcManual.halveMaxHp: Withering: halve this statblock's maximum HP.
LASTARC.NpcManual.halveMaxMp: Dim: halve this statblock's maximum MP.
LASTARC.Warning.WeaponSkillTakeN: Weapon skills cannot Take 10 or Take 20.
LASTARC.Warning.PersistentFloor: Recovery cannot clear persistent steps. This character is held at step {steps} until the underlying condition is cured.
LASTARC.Warning.RecoveryBlocked: Already at the persistent floor — recovery cannot improve the gauge further.
LASTARC.Warning.SecondWind: Second Wind is unavailable: either already used, or HP is above half maximum.
LASTARC.Setting.breakThresholdUsesPostDR: Whether a hit is compared to Break Threshold before or after Damage Reduction is subtracted. The rules are ambiguous (spec §15 A1) and this changes every Break Gauge interaction in the game. Default: after DR.
LASTARC.Setting.heroPointAffectsThreshol: Hero point defence boost raises Break Threshold
A hero point adds 1d6 to a defence. Break Threshold is defined as Fortitude, so this reads as also raising the Threshold mid-turn (spec §15 A2). Default: yes.
LASTARC.Setting.clampAttributeModifier.h: The book states modifiers span −5 to +5, but racial caps reach 22, which computes to +6 (spec §15 A3). Default: clamp.
LASTARC.Setting.multiclassRegrantsLevel1: Whether a second class grants its own defence bonuses, starting technicks and gold (spec §15 A9). Default: no — granted on the first class only.
LASTARC.Setting.maxComboChain.name: Maximum Combo chain length
LASTARC.Setting.maxComboChain.hint: A melee natural 20 grants a free extra attack, which can itself roll a natural 20. The rules do not state a limit (spec §15 A6); this caps the chain defensively.
LASTARC.Tooltip.HeroBoost: Spend a hero point: add an exploding 1d6 to this defence until the start of your next turn. Boosting Fortitude also raises Break Threshold.
LASTARC.Action.DowngradeHint: primary → secondary or minor; secondary → minor
LASTARC.Action.Unaffordable: No action slot available for that.
LASTARC.Action.NoReactionsFlatFooted: Reactions are blocked entirely while flat-footed.
LASTARC.Action.NoFreeActionsFlatFooted: Free actions cannot be used while flat-footed, except spending a hero point.
LASTARC.Action.SequenceInterrupted: Sequence interrupted — {banked} banked minor action(s) lost.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SlotPrimary: Primary action. May be downgraded to a secondary or a minor action.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SlotSecondary: Secondary action. May be downgraded to a minor action.
LASTARC.Tooltip.HoldTurn: Defer to the next combatant. This permanently reorders the tracker for the rest of combat — it is not a one-round delay.
LASTARC.Combat.Held: holds their turn, deferring to the next combatant. The tracker order is permanently changed.
LASTARC.Combat.HoldLast: Already last in the turn order — there is nobody to defer to.
LASTARC.Combat.GroupInitiative: Group initiative ({die}) — the group moves at the pace of its slowest member.
LASTARC.Note.NoAttacks: No attacks. Add one to roll it from this sheet.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RollNpcAttack: Roll this attack. Target a token first to compare against its Reflex — a flat-footed target uses its flat-footed value.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AttackBroken: The printed bonus is the creature's UNBROKEN value. The Break Gauge penalty is applied on top.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AreaNoCrit: Area attacks can neither crit nor combo (§5.1).
LASTARC.Dialog.DeleteAttack.title: Delete Attack
LASTARC.Warning.NoSuchAttack: {name} has no attack at that position — the sheet may be out of date. Close and reopen it.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AdjustmentColumn: Everything affecting this skill that has no column of its own — Break Gauge, armour check penalty, technick bonuses, and granted training or focus. Hover any row to itemise it.
LASTARC.Note.NoSpells: No spells known. Add one below and type in what your book says.
LASTARC.Note.NoPerformances: No performances known. Add one below and type in what your book says.
LASTARC.Note.NoFeatures: Nothing recorded. Add each benefit your race or class grants as its own feature — a description plus the skill or defence bonus it gives.
LASTARC.Tooltip.CreateItem: Create a new one on this character. Its sheet opens so you can enter the numbers from your book.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AddWeapon: Create a weapon, already equipped so it appears here. Unequip it with ○ in Inventory.
LASTARC.Dialog.CreateItem.title: New item
LASTARC.Dialog.CreateItem.content: This system ships with no game content. Name it as your book does, then fill in the numbers on the sheet that opens.
LASTARC.Dialog.CreateItem.name: Name
LASTARC.HighArcana.adamant: Adamant Spell — ignore Break Gauge penalties to the Spellcraft check
LASTARC.HighArcana.distant: Distant Spell — double the spell’s range
LASTARC.HighArcana.enlarged: Enlarged Spell — double the targeted area, not secondary effects
LASTARC.HighArcana.intensified: Intensified Spell — double the number of damage dice
LASTARC.HighArcana.lingering: Lingering Spell — double duration, scaling durations only
LASTARC.HighArcana.multi: Multi-Spell — target extra creatures equal to your Mnd modifier
LASTARC.Card.DecayTick: {amount} at the start of their turn in {n}
LASTARC.Warning.UnknownStatus: This spell applies an unregistered status ({id}). Add it to the status tables.
LASTARC.Tooltip.CastSpell: Cast this spell. Target a token first to compare against its defence.
LASTARC.Tooltip.HighArcana: High Arcana double the MP cost and cannot be stacked. Any MP reduction applies after the doubling.
LASTARC.Card.SpellDisrupted: {spell} was disrupted by a counterattack — the spell fails and {cost} MP is wasted.
LASTARC.Tooltip.Rest: Rest to recover HP and MP. Eight hours within 24 also restores per-day abilities; more than eight yields nothing extra.
LASTARC.Dialog.Rest.title: Rest
LASTARC.Dialog.Rest.blocked: A persistent condition prevents HP recovery from rest.
LASTARC.Card.PerformSkillBonus: Allies gain {n} until the start of your next turn — {scope}. This modifies the d20 check, not the damage roll.
LASTARC.Card.PerformSkillBonusUnscoped: Allies gain {n} until the start of your next turn. This modifies the d20 check, not the damage roll.
LASTARC.Card.SubstitutesDefence: Allies may use {total} in place of their {defence} Defence until the start of your next turn.
LASTARC.Card.PerformanceReplaces: A creature carries one allied and one enemy performance at most; a new one of the same side replaces the old.
LASTARC.Card.PerformanceDisrupted: {name} was disrupted by a counterattack — the performance fails.
LASTARC.Tooltip.Perform: Perform. Shift-click to perform defensively (Instrument −5, Dance and Oratory −2, per threatening creature).
LASTARC.HeroPoint.RerollTooltip: Spend a hero point to reroll this d20. You keep the second result even if it is worse.
LASTARC.HeroPoint.Rerolled: Hero point spent — rerolled {original} into {rerolled}, keeping {kept}.
LASTARC.HeroPoint.BonusRollTooltip: Spend a hero point to add an exploding 1d6 to this result. Keeps the original die, so it cannot make the roll worse.
LASTARC.HighArcana.note.enlarged: Targeted area doubled — secondary effects are not extended.
LASTARC.HighArcana.note.lingering: Duration doubled, where the duration scales.
LASTARC.HighArcana.note.multi: May target additional creatures equal to your Mnd modifier.
LASTARC.HighArcana.note.multiInapplicabl: Multi-Spell has no effect: it only works on spells that target a single creature.
LASTARC.Injury.severedLeg: Severed leg — −5 Agi checks, speed and max bulk halved, cannot charge
LASTARC.Injury.severedArm: Severed arm — −5 Str and Agi checks, no two-handed weapons, reload one step slower
LASTARC.Injury.Permanent: A missing limb cannot be restored — only a prosthetic reduces the penalties.
LASTARC.Tooltip.Capacity: Shots before reloading. 0 for a weapon that never needs it.
LASTARC.Tooltip.BlockBonus: Bonus on the opposed roll made to Block. Block is a reaction, not a flat defence bonus.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AmmoFits: Weapon categories this ammunition fits, comma separated.
LASTARC.Tooltip.HigherLevelTarget: Defence bonus a target of higher level than the caster gains against this spell.
LASTARC.Tooltip.DecayFractions: Damage-over-time ticks, as fractions of the INITIAL damage. "0.5, 0.25" means half then a quarter.
LASTARC.Tooltip.DrInitialOnly: Damage reduction applies to the first hit but never to decay ticks.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SpellDoubledExplosions: This spell's damage dice always double their explosions: each exploding die generates two rather than one. For doubling granted by equipment under a condition, use the caster's Doubled Explosions (Spells) technick flag instead.
LASTARC.Note.Outcomes: What the spell does. The highest row whose DC the Spellcraft check reaches is the one that applies; leave DC blank for a row that always applies.
LASTARC.Note.NoOutcomes: No outcomes yet. A spell with none rolls a check and then does nothing.
LASTARC.Tooltip.OnFailMultiplier: Damage multiplier when an opposed row FAILS — 0.5 for half damage, 0 for none.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PerformSpec: Sets the penalty for performing defensively: −5 for Instrument, −2 for Dance and Oratory.
LASTARC.Note.RaceAttributes: Racial attribute modifiers, then per-attribute caps. Leave a box blank for no entry — blank and 0 are different.
LASTARC.Tooltip.InitiativeDie: Lower is better — initiative is inverted and the lowest result acts first.
LASTARC.Note.ClassItemAdvisory: This records what the class grants. A character's actual class levels are set in the header of their own sheet.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RestoresFully: Whether this undoes the Injury & Dismemberment result completely, or only part of it.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AccessorySlot: Where it is worn — ring, amulet, cloak. Free text; the system does not enforce slot limits.
LASTARC.Tooltip.TechnickKind: Talents come from a class tree; technicks are taken freely.
LASTARC.Tooltip.TalentTree: The class tree this talent belongs to. Leave blank for a technick.
LASTARC.Tooltip.ClassRestricted: Can only be taken in a class's bonus technick slots.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RecoveryMinors: Minor actions a Recovery takes. Blank means the standard three; Shake it Off lowers it to two.
LASTARC.Note.PrereqAttributes: Minimum attribute scores. Leave blank for no requirement.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PersistentSteps: Steps that a Recovery cannot clear until the underlying damage is repaired.
LASTARC.Tooltip.ShieldProficiency: Without it, using a shield costs −5 on attacks the same way non-proficient armour does.
LASTARC.Warning.BadDecayFractions: Some decay fractions were not positive numbers and have been dropped.
LASTARC.Tooltip.ThresholdBonus: Break Threshold bonus from equipment or an effect. Technick grants are added automatically and are not counted here.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RacialMod: Racial attribute modifier, applied after generation. Added to the score to the left.
LASTARC.Tooltip.AttributeCap: Maximum this attribute can reach for this species, 18–22. Recorded for reference; no rule enforces it yet.
LASTARC.Tooltip.LevelDerived: Total character level — the sum of your class levels. Add or raise a class above to level up.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantHp: Flat bonus to maximum HP. Added after any status that halves the maxima, so withering does not eat it.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantDr: Flat damage reduction, on top of any worn armour.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantSkillFocus: Added to this skill's Focus, the same column a character raises by spending skill points.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantSkillBonus: A flat modifier on this skill's total, separate from Focus.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantSkillTrained: Marks the skill trained. Skill Training grants this without the character spending a training slot on it.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantedTrained: A technick trains you in this skill. The tick box beside it records training you chose yourself, so it stays empty — the skill is trained either way, and the allowance below counts this one.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantedFocus: Focus granted by a technick, on top of anything you put in the box.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantedBonus: A flat bonus granted by a technick.
LASTARC.Tooltip.ShareItem: Post this to chat so the rest of the table can read it. Nothing is rolled or spent.
LASTARC.Note.NoNpcSkills: No skills recorded. Statblock skills are printed totals — add the ones the entry lists.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RollNpcSkill: Roll 1d20 plus the printed total and the Break Gauge penalty.
LASTARC.Setting.breakGaugeAffectsThresho: Off by default. The book's Break Gauge penalty is listed as applying to attack rolls, skill checks, attribute checks and defences — Break Threshold is not among them, so it stays constant as you move down the track. Turn this on to derive Threshold from the penalised Fortitude instead, which makes each break easier than the last.
LASTARC.Note.Feature: One named benefit your race or class grants — "Fleet of Foot: +2 Acrobatics". Put the numbers in Grants below and they apply to the character automatically. Everything is typed in by hand from your own book; nothing is looked up.
LASTARC.Tooltip.LegacyRaceItem: Whole-race and whole-class items do not affect the character. Make a Feature instead — one benefit at a time, with its bonus in the Grants panel.
LASTARC.Tooltip.MoveUp: Move this one place up the list.
LASTARC.Tooltip.MoveDown: Move this one place down the list.
LASTARC.Tooltip.SecondWindPip: Tick to spend a use, untick to give it back. Second Wind returns on a rest, and nothing here knows when you took one.
LASTARC.Card.RepeatBlock: Cumulative penalty for {n} earlier block(s) this turn.
LASTARC.Block.OfferTooltip: Roll your shield against the attack. Beat it and the attack is treated as if it did not beat your Reflex.
LASTARC.Block.ShieldTooLarge: That shield is too large to use.
LASTARC.PerformScope.generalSkills: Skill checks (not weapon, Alchemy, Smithing or Spellcraft)
LASTARC.Note.PerformOutcomes: One row per DC tier. The Perform check picks the highest row it reached; a blank DC always applies. A bonus or penalty needs a scope beside it, or nobody can tell what it modifies.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PerformOpposed: Leave blank for a tier that simply applies. Set a defence for a tier gated on beating an enemy — Chapter 9 uses Will throughout.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PerformDamage: Damage the performance itself deals. Always unaspected, so it ignores damage reduction.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PerformMpLoss: Mana stripped from the target. This die EXPLODES — the only resource drain in the system that does.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PerformPenalty: A positive number. It is subtracted, so type what the book prints without the minus sign.
LASTARC.Content.GMOnly: Only a GM can create compendiums.
LASTARC.Content.NoticeTitle: Set up your Last Arc compendiums
LASTARC.Content.NoticeBody: Last Arc ships no game content — everything you author is typed in from your own copy of the book, so it is yours and it must not be lost. It has to live in a world compendium: those sit in the world folder, where a system update can never reach them. Earlier versions declared compendiums belonging to the system itself, and Foundry destroyed those on every update.
LASTARC.Content.NoticeList: Create the standard set now — Races, Classes, Technicks, Talents, Weapons, Armour & Shields, Accessories & Consumables, Spells, Performances and a Bestiary? They will be empty and ready to fill.
LASTARC.Setting.CreateCompendiums.name: Create the Last Arc compendium set
LASTARC.Setting.CreateCompendiums.hint: Tick and save to create the standard world compendiums (Races, Spells, Bestiary and so on) if you do not have them. World compendiums survive system updates. Safe to use more than once — existing ones are left alone.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PrereqTrainedSkills: Skills the character must be trained in, comma separated. Use the skill's key as it appears on the character sheet, e.g. acrobatics.
LASTARC.Tooltip.PrereqSlugs: Comma-separated slugs, matching the slug field of the technick or talent required.
LASTARC.Note.SpoilsRecord: Recorded for reference. Nothing here rolls yet — the tables are a place to keep what your book prints.
LASTARC.Note.NoLoot: Nothing recorded. Add each thing this creature leaves behind and how often it does.
LASTARC.Note.NoSteal: Nothing recorded. Add each thing that can be taken from it and how often the attempt finds it.
LASTARC.NpcManual.why: A printed maximum is an authored number, so the system will not overwrite what you typed. The same curse on a player character is applied automatically.
LASTARC.Note.StatusesTemplateOnly: This is the shared statblock, not a token. Its tokens are unlinked, so statuses toggled here do not reach any creature already on the scene — open the token's own sheet for that.
LASTARC.Note.StatusDuplicates: Applied more than once. Click to remove every copy.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RangeText: Printed range as the statblock words it. Display only — the increments below are what the roll uses.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RangeBands: Upper bound of each band, in squares. Leave at zero and this attack never asks about range. Fill them in and rolling it offers the band picker, applying -2, -5 or -10.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RangeBand.pointBlank: Up to this distance: no penalty.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RangeBand.short: Up to this distance: -2. Leave zero to stop here — this attack simply cannot reach further.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RangeBand.long: Up to this distance: -10. The attack's maximum range.
LASTARC.Tooltip.GrantsReroll: Lets this character reroll a d20 from the chat card. Leave both unticked if the trait does not grant a reroll.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RerollKind.second: Reroll and take the new die, even if it is worse. The gamble — the same rule a hero point uses.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RerollKind.higher: Reroll and keep whichever die was higher. Never worse than not rerolling.
LASTARC.Tooltip.RerollUses: Uses per rest. Leave at 0 for unlimited — the table tracks it.
